## Comparing R packages

The table below compares R packages for working with delayed surveillance data.
Hover over a feature name or a 🟡 for more detail.

✅ Supported.
🟡 Partly supported.
❌ Not supported.
⚙️ Depends on the modelling engine used.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: package-comparison
#| column: page
library(htmltools)

cran <- "https://cran.r-project.org/package="
github <- "https://github.com/"

# Column order and the link for each package header.
packages <- c(
  EpiNow2 = paste0(cran, "EpiNow2"),
  surveillance = paste0(cran, "surveillance"),
  epidist = paste0(cran, "epidist"),
  nowcaster = paste0(cran, "nowcaster"),
  baselinenowcast = paste0(cran, "baselinenowcast"),
  NobBS = paste0(cran, "NobBS"),
  epinowcast = paste0(github, "epinowcast/epinowcast"),
  diseasenowcasting = paste0(github, "RodrigoZepeda/diseasenowcasting"),
  tbl.now = paste0(cran, "tbl.now")
)

# HTML entities, as emoji in R strings break in non-UTF-8 locales.
symbols <- list(
  yes = HTML("&#x2705;"),
  partial = HTML("&#x1F7E1;"),
  no = HTML("&#x274C;"),
  engine = HTML("&#x2699;&#xFE0F;")
)

via_tbl_now <- "Through tbl.now, which loads with the package."
engine_note <- paste(
  "tbl.now fits no models itself.",
  "This depends on the engine used with run_nowcast()."
)

# A package not named in `yes`, `partial` or `engine` is shown as not supported.
feature <- function(label, hint, yes = character(), partial = character(),
                    engine = FALSE, notes = character(), indent = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(
    c(yes, partial) %in% names(packages),
    names(notes) %in% names(packages),
    partial %in% names(notes)
  )
  cells <- lapply(names(packages), function(package) {
    note <- if (package %in% names(notes)) notes[[package]]
    if (package %in% partial) {
      list(text = symbols$partial, label = "Partly supported", note = note)
    } else if (package %in% yes) {
      list(text = symbols$yes, label = "Supported", note = note)
    } else if (engine && package == "tbl.now") {
      list(
        text = symbols$engine, label = "Depends on engine", note = engine_note
      )
    } else {
      list(text = symbols$no, label = "Not supported", note = note)
    }
  })
  list(label = label, hint = hint, cells = cells, indent = indent)
}

# A row of short text values, one for every package.
text_feature <- function(label, hint, values, notes = character()) {
  stopifnot(setequal(names(values), names(packages)))
  cells <- lapply(names(packages), function(package) {
    note <- if (package %in% names(notes)) notes[[package]]
    list(text = values[[package]], label = NULL, note = note)
  })
  list(label = label, hint = hint, cells = cells, indent = FALSE)
}

# `title` keeps the text available if the tooltip script does not run.
with_tooltip <- function(content, text, class = NULL) {
  tags$span(
    content,
    class = class, title = text, tabindex = "0",
    `data-bs-toggle` = "tooltip"
  )
}

feature_cell <- function(cell) {
  content <- cell$text
  if (!is.null(cell$label)) {
    content <- tags$span(
      cell$text, role = "img", `aria-label` = cell$label
    )
  }
  tags$td(
    if (is.null(cell$note)) {
      content
    } else {
      with_tooltip(content, cell$note, class = "has-note")
    }
  )
}

feature_row <- function(row) {
  # A plain string is a subsection heading rather than a feature.
  if (is.character(row)) {
    return(tags$tr(
      class = "subsection",
      tags$th(
        tags$span(row),
        scope = "colgroup", colspan = length(packages) + 1
      )
    ))
  }
  tags$tr(
    tags$th(
      with_tooltip(row$label, row$hint, class = "has-hint"),
      scope = "row", class = if (row$indent) "indented"
    ),
    lapply(row$cells, feature_cell)
  )
}

section_rows <- function(name) {
  tagList(
    tags$tr(
      class = "section",
      tags$th(
        tags$span(name),
        scope = "colgroup", colspan = length(packages) + 1
      )
    ),
    lapply(sections[[name]], feature_row)
  )
}

tagList(
  tags$div(
    class = "package-comparison",
    tags$table(
      class = "table",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(
        tags$th("Feature", scope = "col"),
        lapply(names(packages), function(package) {
          tags$th(
            tags$a(tags$code(package), href = packages[[package]]),
            scope = "col"
          )
        })
      )),
      tags$tbody(lapply(names(sections), section_rows))
    )
  ),
  tags$script(HTML(
    "document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      document
        .querySelectorAll('.package-comparison [data-bs-toggle=\"tooltip\"]')
        .forEach(function (element) {
          new bootstrap.Tooltip(element, { customClass: 'package-tooltip' });
        });
    });"
  ))
)
```

::: {.callout-tip}
`epidist` estimates delay distributions and does not produce nowcasts.
`tbl.now` prepares and diagnoses data, then passes it to another package.
It can pass data to all the packages listed except `epidist` and `nowcaster`.
::: 

> Features were checked against each package's source code on November 2026.
